biotools.summary: This is an R/shiny package to perform functional enrichment analysis for microbiome data. This package was based on clusterProfiler. Moreover, MicrobiomeProfiler support KEGG enrichment analysis, COG enrichment analysis, Microbe-Disease association enrichment analysis, Metabo-Pathway analysis.
